Control room UPS, GIS DC system

LEVEL 2 · SUPERVISORY – SCADA LAN, VLAN 10, 10.10.10.0/24 (CONTROL ROOM)
LEVEL 1 · CONTROL – M580 PLANT CONTROLLER, VLAN 20, 10.10.20.0/24
LEVEL 0 · FIELD DEVICES – DEVICE NETWORK, VLAN 30, 10.10.30.0/24, AND SERIAL BUSES
Device; stripe = interface type to SCADA
1. Architecture follows the Schneider Electric offer
(Villa Somalia v1) and drawing BFE/PR/26/01. Device
names are used unchanged on sheets 002–005, the HMI
2. The M580 is the plant controller (PPC): it dispatches
BESS, PV and DG setpoints. Protection relays trip
3. BMEP582040 is not hot-standby capable. The second CPU
in the BOM is shown as a cold spare. Change to an M580
hot-standby CPU if redundancy is required (TBC).
4. SCADA server, historian, engineering station, GPS clock
and firewall are not in the BOM and must be added
5. Field switches at remote locations, BESS EMS interface,
DG controller interface and FACP interface are not in
6. Only the firewall conduit connects Level 2 to Level 3.
Remote access is subject to client approval.
7. Equipment locations and cable distances to be confirmed
